meta.name: analytical-method-validation
meta.description: Plan, execute, and document validation, verification, and transfer of analytical procedures under the governing framework - ICH Q2(R2) and Q14, USP <1220>/<1225>/<1226>, ICH M10 bioanalytical, CLSI EP, or ISO/IEC 17025. Use for HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC, CE, ICP-MS, dissolution, qNMR, qPCR, NIR, and ligand binding or cell-based assays whenever the question is whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose. Triggers include "method validation", "analytical method validation", "AMV", "validation protocol", "acceptance criteria", "linearity", "reportable range", "accuracy and precision", "repeatability", "intermediate precision", "recovery", "LOD", "LOQ", "detection limit", "quantitation limit", "specificity", "robustness", "method transfer", "method comparison", "Deming", "Passing-Bablok", "Bland-Altman", "equivalence testing", "OOS investigation", "ICH Q2", "Q2(R2)", "Q14", "USP 1225", "ICH M10", "incurred sample reanalysis", "ISR", "CLSI EP", and any request to show that an assay works.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把关分析检测方法是否经得起验证审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要给实验室检测方法准备验证和证明材料。
copy.tagline_en: Prove your lab method is reliable for its intended use before release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must show an analytical method is fit for its intended purpose under regulations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先确定适用哪套法规框架(如 ICH Q2(R2)、USP),再规划验证研究、计算线性/准确度/精密度/检测限等统计量,并生成验证协议与文档。它只报告,不做合格判定。
howto.when: 当你提到“方法验证”、“AMV”、“方法转移”等关键词,或要判断某个分析规程(如 HPLC、LC-MS/MS)是否适用于其预期用途时触发。

say.text: 用 ICH Q2(R2) 帮我为 HPLC 含量测定生成一份验证方案
say.note: 输出带待填接受标准的协议骨架

say.text: 检查这条标准曲线的线性,给出失拟检验和回算误差
say.note: 会指出 r² 高但模型不可用的情况

say.text: 比较两个方法在预设 2% 范围内是否等效
say.note: 用 TOST 等值检验而非 t 检验

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude pins down the governing framework (e.g. ICH Q2(R2), USP), then plans studies, computes linearity, accuracy/precision and detection limits via scripts, and drafts protocols. It only reports, never concludes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "method validation", "AMV" or "method transfer", or ask whether an analytical procedure (e.g. HPLC, LC-MS/MS) is fit for its intended purpose.

say_en.text: Use ICH Q2(R2) to draft a validation protocol for an HPLC assay.
say_en.note: Outputs a protocol skeleton with blanks for criteria

say_en.text: Check this curve's linearity with lack-of-fit and back-calculated error.
say_en.note: Flags high r2 with an unusable model

say_en.text: Are these two methods equivalent within a pre-set 2% margin?
say_en.note: Uses TOST equivalence testing, not a t-test
